scope: Signed native Android microphone to installed gateway, explicit server recording endpoint and a Web audience on the same Example upstream. Synthetic source, not human speech or physical mobile acceptance.

source.mechanism: Official emulator authenticated loopback gRPC injectAudio, started only after native microphone_live became true
source.format: mono PCM16LE, 48000 Hz, -18 dBFS, paced 20ms packets for 5 seconds

target.name: Stream Kit Virtual Audio
target.route: Explicit session local render/capture pair, no default-device changes
target.recorder: Existing native diagnostic recorder; no claim that UE itself opened this endpoint

earlier_failure: Injecting before active Android capture stalled the isolated AVD; retained as a fixture limitation, not a product pass. This successful run established active native capture first and did not call setMicrophoneState.
not_proven: Non-silent signal suppression after control transfer (capture stop has separate evidence)
Physical device or human microphone behavior
